production_notes: Short front vowel; sustain cleanly without gliding toward a neighboring vowel.
dialect_notes: Exact height and backness varies across dialects.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation with a clean onset and release. Avoid adding a schwa before or after.

production_notes: Mid front vowel; keep steady without gliding.
dialect_notes: May approach /e/ in some varieties.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation; sustain without tensing toward a higher vowel.

production_notes: High-lax front vowel; keep lax and brief without reducing to schwa.
dialect_notes: Unstressed reduction must be avoided in the model recording.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation as a clear stressed syllable-nucleus quality.

production_notes: Low back unrounded vowel; sustain without rounding or raising.
dialect_notes: Cot–caught contrast is dialect-sensitive; recorder must preserve low-back unrounded quality.
recording_guidance: Record as an open, unrounded low back vowel; avoid merging with /ɔ/.

production_notes: Mid-central stressed vowel; keep distinct from the unstressed schwa.
dialect_notes: Keep distinct from schwa in the stressed model; some regional accents raise this vowel.
recording_guidance: Record in a stressed context to prevent schwa reduction.

production_notes: Sustain through one smooth glide from mid-front to high-front; do not clip the movement.
dialect_notes: Dynamic realization varies; some dialects produce a purer monophthong.
recording_guidance: Record as a natural diphthong in isolation; let the glide complete.

production_notes: High front tense vowel; sustain without breaking into a diphthong.
dialect_notes: Often narrowly diphthongal phonetically in American English.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation; aim for a steady, tense quality.

production_notes: Sustain through one smooth glide from low-central to high-front; complete the movement.
dialect_notes: Dynamic realization varies; Canadian raising may alter the onset before voiceless consonants.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation as a full diphthong; let the glide complete naturally.

production_notes: Sustain through one smooth glide from mid-back to high-back; do not clip.
dialect_notes: Degree of glide varies; some dialects produce a purer monophthong.
recording_guidance: Record as a natural diphthong; let the glide complete.

production_notes: Palatal glide /j/ followed immediately by high back vowel /u/; record as a single instructional target.
dialect_notes: Not a single phoneme; SLP must approve as a combined instructional target before final recording.
recording_guidance: Record as one smooth sequence without pausing between the glide and vowel.

production_notes: Mid-low back rounded vowel; keep rounded and distinct from /ɑ/.
dialect_notes: Cot–caught merger risk; SLP must confirm contrast policy and recorder capability before recording.
recording_guidance: Record as a clearly rounded back vowel; verify the recorder preserves the caught–cot contrast.

production_notes: High-lax back rounded vowel; keep distinct from the tense /u/.
dialect_notes: Keep clearly distinct from /u/; some dialects merge these before certain consonants.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation as a lax, short quality; avoid diphthongal movement.

production_notes: High-tense back rounded vowel; sustain without breaking.
dialect_notes: Often has a glide or fronted onset in American English.
recording_guidance: Record as a steady tense quality; minimize any fronted onset.

production_notes: Mid-central reduced vowel; keep brief and unstressed.
dialect_notes: Avoid turning it into stressed /ʌ/ in the model; exaggerating this vowel is pedagogically misleading.
recording_guidance: Record as a genuinely brief, unstressed quality; do not lengthen or stress.

production_notes: Low back vowel with rhotic coloring; sustain with consistent rhoticity.
dialect_notes: Rhotic reference; exact phonetic analysis varies. Non-rhotic dialects should not be used for recording.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation with full rhoticity; avoid weakening the rhotic quality.

production_notes: Stressed rhotic central vowel; sustain with consistent rhoticity.
dialect_notes: Tongue posture varies between bunched and retroflex; both produce equivalent auditory result.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation; aim for a consistent, easily perceptible rhotic quality.

production_notes: Mid-back rounded vowel with rhotic coloring; sustain with rounding and rhoticity.
dialect_notes: Horse–hoarse and cot–caught contrasts vary; SLP should confirm contrast policy.
recording_guidance: Record with clear rounding and rhoticity in isolation.

production_notes: Sustain through one smooth glide from mid-back rounded to high-front; complete the movement.
dialect_notes: Dynamic realization varies across dialects.
recording_guidance: Record as a full natural diphthong; let the glide complete.

production_notes: Sustain through one smooth glide from low-central to high-back; complete the movement.
dialect_notes: Dynamic realization varies; Canadian raising may alter the onset before voiceless consonants.
recording_guidance: Record as a full natural diphthong in isolation; let the glide complete.

production_notes: Voiceless glottal fricative; keep brief without a following vowel.
dialect_notes: Realization varies; avoid adding a following vowel in the model.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation with a brief, airy onset; do not add /ə/ after.

production_notes: Voiceless bilabial stop; produce the burst without a schwa release.
dialect_notes: No schwa release; aspirate naturally in onset position.
recording_guidance: Record the burst only; no trailing vowel. Slight aspiration is natural.

production_notes: Voiced bilabial stop; minimal voicing, no schwa after the burst.
dialect_notes: No schwa; voicing may be incomplete at burst onset.
recording_guidance: Record the burst; keep it tight and free of trailing vowel.

production_notes: Bilabial nasal; keep lips closed and sustain nasal resonance.
dialect_notes: Keep lips closed throughout; avoid nasalizing an adjacent vowel.
recording_guidance: Record as a steady nasal hum with lips together.

production_notes: Voiceless labiodental fricative; maintain continuous airflow.
dialect_notes: Keep continuous; avoid stopping the airflow mid-sustain.
recording_guidance: Record as a steady frication; upper teeth lightly on lower lip.

production_notes: Voiced labiodental fricative; preserve voicing throughout.
dialect_notes: Keep voicing consistent; avoid devoicing at end of sustain.
recording_guidance: Record as a steady voiced frication; check for buzzy voicing quality.

production_notes: Voiceless dental fricative; tongue tip near upper teeth, no voicing.
dialect_notes: Keep separate from voiced /ð/; TH-stopping dialects should not be used as the reference recording.
recording_guidance: Record as steady voiceless frication; check for absence of voicing.

production_notes: Voiced dental fricative; tongue tip near upper teeth, with voicing.
dialect_notes: Keep separate from voiceless /θ/; TH-stopping dialects should not be used as the reference recording.
recording_guidance: Record as steady voiced frication; confirm voicing is present throughout.

production_notes: Voiceless alveolar stop; no schwa, do not model the intervocalic flap.
dialect_notes: No schwa release; do not use a flapped realization as the reference.
recording_guidance: Record the burst only; natural aspiration is fine. No trailing vowel.

production_notes: Voiced alveolar stop; minimal voicing, no schwa after.
dialect_notes: No schwa; voicing may be incomplete at burst onset in some positions.
recording_guidance: Record the burst; keep it tight and free of trailing vowel.

production_notes: Alveolar nasal; keep tongue placement at the alveolar ridge stable throughout.
dialect_notes: Keep tongue placement stable; avoid velarizing into /ŋ/.
recording_guidance: Record as a steady nasal resonance with tongue tip on alveolar ridge.

production_notes: Voiceless alveolar fricative; avoid retracting tongue toward /ʃ/.
dialect_notes: Avoid /ʃ/ retraction; keep tongue tip near alveolar ridge.
recording_guidance: Record as a steady high-frequency frication without retraction.

production_notes: Voiced alveolar fricative; preserve voicing throughout.
dialect_notes: Keep voicing consistent; avoid devoicing at end of sustain.
recording_guidance: Record as a steady voiced frication; check for buzzing quality.

production_notes: Model the onset 'light l'; avoid final dark-l vocalization.
dialect_notes: Model onset position 'light l'; dark-l vocalization should not be the reference.
recording_guidance: Record in an onset context or in isolation as a clear lateral; tongue tip on alveolar ridge.

production_notes: Voiceless postalveolar fricative; one sound target, separate from the grapheme mapping.
dialect_notes: No significant dialect variation for the core target.
recording_guidance: Record as a steady hushing frication; tongue retracted past alveolar ridge.

production_notes: Voiced postalveolar fricative; rare in initial position, use a medial example.
dialect_notes: Initial /ʒ/ is very rare in English; medial example is preferred.
recording_guidance: Record in isolation with voicing; use the medial quality of 'measure' as the tonal model.

production_notes: Preserve the natural brief fricated release; affricate, not a simple stop.
dialect_notes: No significant dialect variation for the core target.
recording_guidance: Record as the natural affricate burst + frication; do not suppress the fricative component.

production_notes: Voiced postalveolar affricate; preserve the natural brief fricated release, no schwa.
dialect_notes: No significant dialect variation for the core target.
recording_guidance: Record as the natural affricate with voiced frication; keep tight, no trailing vowel.

production_notes: Palatal glide; keep brief and distinct from the letter name.
dialect_notes: Keep distinct from the letter name 'wye'; model the phoneme, not the letter.
recording_guidance: Record as a short palatal glide; do not sustain into a vowel.

production_notes: Rhotic approximant; both bunched and retroflex tongue postures produce the same auditory target.
dialect_notes: Bunched and retroflex realizations are both valid; use whichever is more natural for the recorder.
recording_guidance: Record in onset position; sustain with consistent rhoticity.

production_notes: Voiceless velar stop; no schwa after the burst.
dialect_notes: No schwa; natural aspiration in onset position is fine.
recording_guidance: Record the burst only with natural aspiration; no trailing vowel.

production_notes: Voiced velar stop; minimal voicing, no schwa.
dialect_notes: No schwa; voicing may be incomplete at burst onset.
recording_guidance: Record the burst; keep tight with no trailing vowel.

production_notes: Velar nasal; do not append /g/ to the isolated target.
dialect_notes: Do not add a following /g/; the isolated nasal is the target, not a stop-nasal cluster.
recording_guidance: Record as a sustained velar nasal resonance; tongue back on velum, no trailing stop.

production_notes: Voiceless labiovelar; keep brief and distinct from /w/.
dialect_notes: Wine–whine merger is common; SLP must decide whether to retain as a UFLI target for this reference dialect.
recording_guidance: Record as a voiceless labiovelar frication/approximant; verify the recorder preserves the wine–whine contrast.

production_notes: Voiced labiovelar glide; keep brief and distinct from /ʍ/ if contrast is preserved.
dialect_notes: Contrast with /ʍ/ is dialect-sensitive; contrast may not be available in all recorders.
recording_guidance: Record as a short voiced labiovelar onset glide.
